system.description:
Add-On (Passive): Add-Ons are made to an item with the Clothes Set property. They take no item slot: denote them on the Clothing Set to which they are added.

Belt (Passive): In a pinch, a belt can be used as 5ft of rope. You may add a maximum of 1 belt to any Clothing Set.

No Item Slot · 1gc · Clothing Add-Ons, rulebook p.199
